label: Navigate / GPS / BLE / IGC repeat after UART character yielding
working_tree: Character-yield source committed after this exact binary was built; unchanged installed firmware identified by source manifest and binary hash
scenario: Physical Leaf on Navigate; 117.461-second recorded interval. Operator described a repeat approximately 90-second run after the previous accidental self-test capture; no self-test reported this time. 225 normal Navigate renders and 1657 complete UART GPS sentences.
sd_card: Installed Leaf SD card; model and capacity not recorded
coverage_notes: Captured settings match revision 3: BLE enabled; FANET and optional diagnostic SD logs disabled; thermal features enabled. Connected BLE-client traffic unverified. All 1657 sentences parser-checksum accepted; no omitted/nested/asynchronous/unassigned/partial-ingestion sentences or UART assembly resets. Latest IGC has 130 valid fix records at one-second intervals without gaps. Exact monotonic overlap is not encoded. Navigate is the only measured flight page. Buttons/menu navigation and recovery are separately retained.
limitations: Short manual bench run with at least 114 normal samples per slot; not automated operational qualification. Prior clean run is 80.691 seconds; durations, GPS phase and GSV counts differ, so formal baseline comparison is withheld. Enabled radios do not establish verified traffic. No independent full-profiler overhead calibration or hardware UART overflow counters. No claim of long-term memory stability or sensor-recovery correctness. A normal slot-78 start/barometer delay of 7.663/7.719 ms is retained only as a maximum; its event predecessor is unavailable and its cause cannot be reconstructed.

igc_evidence.limitations: Latest IGC associated by device session. Exact monotonic capture overlap is not encoded. No position records copied; continuity does not establish every sensor deadline or UART byte reception.

interpretation: 32/1657 GPS sentences cross deadlines (1.93%), maximum sentence lateness 0.354 ms, versus 75/1057 (7.10%) and 1.825 ms before character yielding. Observational comparison, not a controlled causal estimate. Normal slots still show 156 shallow crossings, maximum 0.386 ms, with zero accumulated-duration overruns and zero coalesced ticks. Heap ends 32 B above start, zero allocation failures, largest free block unchanged. Button recovery has 3 coalesced ticks and delays; slot 78 also has an unexplained normal barometer-call delay and needs follow-up. This capture does not establish wider individual GPS bursts from the phase chart.
